title: Wind Tunnel — Aero Test Lab
description: A real lattice-Boltzmann wind tunnel: sculpt a body, sweep the angle of attack, read lift and drag, export the run.
concept: A working D2Q9 lattice-Boltzmann solver runs a virtual wind tunnel at 60fps in a single HTML file. Load a NACA airfoil, a cylinder, a car or a city skyline — or paint your own body straight onto the flow with a brush — then sweep the angle of attack and watch the vorticity field, pressure map or schlieren shading respond. Forces on the body are measured by momentum exchange at every bounce-back link, so the lift and drag coefficients on the HUD are computed from the flow rather than faked, and a live sparkline shows the Karman vortex street shaking the lift trace. Runs can be exported as an annotated PNG, saved as JSON, or packed into a share link.
features: D2Q9 lattice-Boltzmann solver with half-way bounce-back walls and momentum-exchange force measurement
Nine test bodies — NACA 2412 and 0015 sections, cylinder, flat plate, wedge, square, car, skyline — with live angle-of-attack and size sweeps
Brush sculpting: draw and erase barrier cells directly on the running flow
Five visualisation modes (vorticity, speed, pressure, schlieren, streamwise u) across six palettes, with tracer streaklines and a velocity probe grid
Live Cd / Cl / L-over-D / Reynolds readout plus a scrolling force sparkline
Export an annotated PNG, save or load the run as JSON, and copy a share link that carries the sculpted body in the URL hash

interaction.mouse: Drag across the tunnel to sculpt or erase the test body; sliders sweep angle of attack, wind speed and viscosity
interaction.click: Pick a preset body, a visualisation mode or a palette; export PNG, save JSON or copy a share link
interaction.touch: Drag to sculpt on the canvas; the control panel opens as a bottom sheet from the Controls button
interaction.keyboard: Space pause, R reset flow, C clear tunnel, E toggle draw/erase, T tracers, V cycle view mode, P export PNG
